tamedphantoms.configuration.taming.immor: On: a full loop in the saddle makes that phantom immortal and grants a secret advancement. Off: loops grant nothing, and phantoms that are already immortal become ordinary on their next tick. Applies without a restart.
tamedphantoms.configuration.flight.owned: Speed of your own tamed phantoms only. This server's maximum is %s. The slider stops there: a higher value is cut down to the server maximum.
tamedphantoms.configuration.scream.stack: On: several screams heard at once last longer, and from the third one they also deal a little damage. Nine screams are the cap: eight seconds of blindness and ten damage. Off: every scream is one second of blindness. On by default.
tamedphantoms.scream.cooldown: The phantom's scream will be ready in %s s.
tamedphantoms.cruise.on: The phantom flies on by itself
tamedphantoms.cruise.off: The phantom listens to you again
advancements.tamedphantoms.dead_loop.des: Pull a loop on a phantom. That phantom will glow, and it will not die
advancements.tamedphantoms.sick_moon.des: Hear a released phantom cry under a full moon
advancements.tamedphantoms.what_filth.de: Offer a tamed phantom a potion of Healing
advancements.tamedphantoms.nasty_heal.de: Heal a tamed phantom with a potion of Harming
advancements.tamedphantoms.sensory_overl: Give a tamed phantom a potion of Night Vision
tamedphantoms.guide.name: Phantom Taming Guide
tamedphantoms.guide.subtitle: A night-sky companion
tamedphantoms.guide.landing: This book explains how to live alongside phantoms: how to tame one, how to fly with it, how to let it rest, and what happens if you set it free.$(br2)If you lose the book, you can make another from a $(item)book$() and a $(item)phantom membrane$().
tamedphantoms.guide.cat.intro.desc: A short look at what changed for phantoms, and how this book is meant to be used.
tamedphantoms.guide.cat.taming.desc: How a wild phantom becomes yours, how to look after it, and how to release it.
tamedphantoms.guide.cat.riding.desc: The saddle, sitting still, and flying through the dark.
tamedphantoms.guide.cat.combat.desc: How a tamed or released phantom defends itself, and how strong it is.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.welcome.1: Welcome. This guide was written for travelers who want to understand phantoms without guessing. The chapters that follow go through each part of the bond in order, from the first meeting to life in the air.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.welcome.2: You will find how a wild phantom can be tamed, how it is fed and led, how it is saddled, how it sits, and how it answers a blow. Nothing here is required reading. Open a page when you need it.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.welcome.3: A new copy can be made at a crafting table from an ordinary book and a phantom membrane.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.welcome.4: If you found a bug or just want to share feedback, you can leave it here: $(l:https://github.com/Nergan/tamedphantoms-mod/issues)https://github.com/Nergan/tamedphantoms-mod/issues$(/l)
tamedphantoms.guide.page.wild.1: A wild phantom now watches the world with $(warn)blood-red eyes$(). If you hold the taming item, it will come closer instead of turning away. Night is still dangerous, but the first step is simply to be seen holding something it wants.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.wild.2: By default that item is a $(item)cookie$(). The item can be changed in the server settings. Wild phantoms are afraid of tamed and released ones: near them they drop their prey and climb away.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.tame.1: Stand near a wild phantom and use the taming item with the right mouse button. If the attempt succeeds, the phantom becomes yours. It grows a little larger and darker, and its eyes turn a bright $(#33cc44)green$(). Hearts appear above it when the bond is made.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.tame.2: By default every attempt succeeds. The chance can be changed in the server settings. A phantom that was released can be tamed again in the same way. Free phantoms of that kind have bright $(#e8c400)yellow eyes$().
tamedphantoms.guide.page.care.1: Anyone can feed a tamed phantom ordinary food, and it restores health. If the phantom is hurt and the owner or another player holds that food nearby, it stops, turns its head toward them, and nods. At full health it does not nod, and the motion stops as soon as the item is put away.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.care.4: Only the owner can offer a poisonous potato or the release item: the phantom still stops and turns, but shakes its head from side to side, and someone else's click sends up angry clouds. Food held by a rider of that phantom does not count, and a phantom that already has a rider does not stop.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.care.3: A lead can be attached with the right mouse button, and taken off the same way with an empty hand. While leashed, the phantom stays close and drifts nearby instead of following in a straight line. To tie it to a fence, use the fence: a sitting phantom up to twelve blocks away is tied too, and a click that lands on the phantom with the fence right behind it ties it as well. A released phantom will not abide a lead: it drifts aside and snaps free.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.care.2: Sunlight will not burn it, and it will not drown. If you travel too far, it will appear beside you again, the way a wolf returns when it has been left behind.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.care.6: Glow berries make it glow for eight seconds. A stew leaves the bowl in your hand, and honey leaves the bottle. Milk clears every effect, uses up the milk, and leaves the bucket. The phantom nods at milk the way it nods at food, even at full health. Hunger inverts the controls while it lasts. Speed, slowness, jump boost, levitation, slow falling, and dolphin's grace change the flight the same way they change you. Strength changes the bite. Flying out of lava makes it shake off lava sparks.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.care.5: Food does more than heal. A poisoned meal poisons the phantom, a golden apple regenerates it, and a chorus fruit teleports it, the same way those foods work on you. A drinkable potion, used with the right mouse button, applies that potion. Splash and lingering potions are thrown, not poured. Instant Health makes that one phantom angry at you and grants What Is This Filth?! Instant Harm heals it and grants Nasty Healing. Weakness only reduces its attack, the same way it does for you. A potion of Fire Resistance, drinkable or splash, gives Resistance for the same time and the same strength, because the phantom does not burn. Night Vision inverts the colors of anyone riding that phantom for as long as the potion lasts, and grants Sensory Overload. The night vision you get just from riding is not this potion, and it does not invert the picture.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.release.1: To release a phantom, use the release item with the right mouse button. By default that item is a $(item)poisonous potato$(). The bond ends, the saddle falls to the ground if there was one, and small angry clouds rise above it. Its eyes turn $(#e8c400)yellow$().
tamedphantoms.guide.page.release.2: A released phantom still defends itself if it is hurt. Anyone who brings the taming item can try to tame it again. It is no longer a pet, but it is not an ordinary wild hunter either.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.saddle.1: Only the owner can place a $(item)saddle$() on a tamed phantom. Use it with the right mouse button. A thin mark of leather appears along the back. With an empty hand, the same button lets you climb on. $(thing)Shears$() take the saddle off again. If the phantom dies, the saddle drops beside it.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.saddle.2: You cannot climb onto a phantom that is sitting. Get down first if you want it to rest. If the owner is already flying, another player may take the place behind them.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.flight.1: While you are riding, the movement keys send the phantom forward, back, and to the sides. Jump makes it climb. The left Control key makes it descend. It turns with your look. You and anyone sitting behind you receive $(thing)Night Vision$() for as long as you stay in the air. More than eight blocks above the surface, the first Shift only asks if that is a bit high. A second press within a second lets either the owner or the rider behind get down.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.flight.2: These keys can be changed in the game controls, under the Tamed Phantoms section. The phantom keeps its speed: climbing spends it, diving builds it, and beating wings push only up to cruising speed. Let go of forward and it glides on, slowly losing height and speed, until it hangs in the air. Back brakes harder and then hovers. Its body leans into turns, and a sharp turn at speed bleeds a little speed.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.flight.3: Dive without forward and the phantom folds its wings back like a falcon: the fall is steeper and much faster, and that speed stays for a few seconds after you level out. Climb on it, or fly far with it. Double-tap jump while flying forward fast enough, and the phantom flies a whole loop. Too slow, and it stalls before the top and drops its nose. Double-tap left or right for a quick barrel roll that also slips aside.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.flight.4: Double-tap forward for cruise: the phantom flies on by itself, and the camera still steers it. Any movement key hands control back, and both changes are shown above the hotbar. The camera follows part of a climb or dive and all of a loop. If the server allows immortal phantoms, a full loop grants a secret advancement, and that phantom glows from then on and will not die. The setting is off by default.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.sit.1: Only the owner can ask a phantom to sit, and only while not riding it. If there is no saddle, use the right mouse button. If there is a saddle, sneak and use the right mouse button. The phantom turns over, falls, and stays where it lands. Falling does not hurt it. A breath of wind marks the command.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.sit.2: You cannot ride a sitting phantom. If something strikes it, it will rise and fight back.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.sit.3: A phantom that is flying with you, or waiting nearby, follows if you go so far that its chunk unloads. It appears beside you in open air, not inside a wall, lava, fire, or a cactus. A phantom you told to sit stays where you left it, even if that chunk unloads. In the client config, the button Where are my phantoms writes every one of yours into chat: whether it is sitting or moving, and where it last was.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.defense.1: If a tamed or released phantom is hurt, it turns on whoever struck it. This lasts about ten seconds and can be changed in the server settings. Even the owner is not spared. While it is ready to attack, its eyes glow $(warn)blood-red$(). When the anger passes, they return to green or yellow.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.defense.2: A released phantom defends itself in the same way. A tamed phantom also keeps wild phantoms from crowding its owner. Phantoms stand together against a player: anger a released phantom, and every released phantom within thirty-two blocks joins in; anger someone's tamed phantom, even your own, and all of that owner's phantoms turn on you.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.scream.1: While the owner is riding, press $(k:key.tamedphantoms.scream)$() (R by default). The phantom lets out a deep, much louder cry. For one second its eyes burn red, and a glow outlines its body. Mobs within range flee and go blind for that second. Anyone sitting on this phantom is spared. The owner on the ground is not, if the phantom screams while defending itself. The first time you do this, you earn the advancement $(thing)Winged Beast$().
tamedphantoms.guide.page.scream.2: The cry then needs about four seconds to return. If it is not ready, a red line tells you how long is left. Radius and cooldown are server settings. A phantom that is defending itself cries the same way, on the same cooldown. On a full moon a released phantom may cry even when it is not fighting: the eyes stay yellow, the glow still flashes, nearby mobs still flee, nobody is blinded, and the moon turns a sickly yellow for that second. Anyone who has that chunk loaded can hear it. Hearing that cry grants the secret advancement $(thing)Sick Moon$().
tamedphantoms.guide.page.scream.3: A cry blinds for one second. If several phantoms cry at you in the same moment, the blindness lasts longer: two cries last two seconds, and nine or more last eight. From the third cry, players and mobs take a little magic damage that ignores armor, more if they were close, up to ten health at nine cries. Mobs stay afraid longer the same way. Only wild phantoms are frightened. Tamed and released ones ignore every cry. An owner who is riding any of their phantoms, and anyone riding with them, is spared from all of that owner's phantoms. The server option stacked screams turns the longer effect on; it is on by default. With it off, one cry is still one second of blindness, and extra cries do not add.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.scream.4: When you press the scream key while riding, every other tamed phantom of yours that can hear that cry answers at once, even if its own cry was not ready yet. A cry made in self-defense, in play, or under a full moon does not call them.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.stats.1: A tamed or released phantom is stronger than a wild one. It has forty health, its bite deals twelve damage, and it flies faster. Each time it wounds something, it heals itself for the same amount.
tamedphantoms.guide.page.stats.2: By default it is about one and a half times an ordinary phantom. The server sets the size of tamed and released phantoms. The night remains unsafe. A bonded phantom simply shares that danger with you.
tamedphantoms.guide.md.landing:
This book explains how to live alongside phantoms: how to tame one, how to fly with it, how to let it rest, and what happens if you set it free.

If you lose the book, you can make another from a **book** and a **phantom membrane**.
